name: zc_fire_shipped

tests.name: the approved flame surface is still what is on disk: translucent, softened, tapered

detail.note: the founder approved a SURFACE. Translucent rather than additive, with the noise-cut edge and the tip falloff, is what distinguishes it from the plume it replaced -- so a silent revert of the asset must not be able to pass as a shipped fire just because the name matches.

tests.name: a fresh session already has the fire material on, with nobody typing anything

detail.note: THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN IMPLEMENTED AND SHIPPED. zc_fire_params set this to 1 itself and then proved the material worked, which is why item 4 was reported as done while a founder booting the game still saw the old plume.

tests.name: Relay OG is back on the Dog and the shipped fire setting is restored
every flame mascot draws the approved fire material at the shipped default

detail.note: read off the instance the figure is WEARING, not off the asset -- an approved material that no component references is not a shipped fire.

tests.name: with the knob forced off the fire material is gone, so the reading tracks the setting

detail.note: THE CONTROL, and the reason this run is worth doing. 'A material with Fire in its name was found' proves nothing if it is found in both states: the clause would be satisfied by a figure that ignores the setting entirely.

tests.name: the flame being DRAWN carries the approved softness and falloff, not just the right name

detail.note: a material instance can override its parent's scalars. The founder approved the shaped surface, so the shaping has to survive to the instance that renders.
